provisional.why: The owner asked for the first film (2026-11-18, 'go i wont review it') before any film of this kind of ours existed. The reference is his own script, not a finished video, so nothing here is measured from a picture.

borrowed.film.seconds: His script: 'Target duration: 1:40-1:50'. The range is that with ten seconds each side.
borrowed.film.words: His script has about 150 spoken words; ours has about 200. No reference video to count.
borrowed.film.shotSeconds: One script line holds a whole stretch of action under it (the training, the busy shop), cut into several angles with `cut:`. So the limit on one LINE is long. The limit on one PICTURE is in README.md: nothing holds over 3 seconds.
borrowed.sound: Topics/InThisTown/topic.json, with the changes named in sound.note.

provisional.whenTheReferenceArrives: When the owner approves a film of this topic, or sends the reel he took the format from: measure its length, words, cuts and sound, replace the borrowed numbers, name the film in `reference` and `models`, and delete this block and `state`.

origin.what: A format the owner found on a reel and wrote his own script for on 2026-11-18: the 'While they're out partying btw' and 'huss huss huss' memes told as a one-and-three-quarter-minute story. His corrections to our first draft are the rules of the topic.
origin.owner: its IRL coated with minecraft. No nether, no mc shenanigans. its a recreation cmon.

premise.oneLiner: A real-life story from a meme, recreated with block people in a block town. Somebody skips every party to train one ordinary skill, far too seriously, and the people who laughed need it at the end.
mustHave: frame one is the skill at full speed and its result, readable with the sound off
a question asked in the hook and answered in the last scene
a real place, a real job, real things: a house, a street, a shop
the first failure, on somebody who did not ask for it
a training run with at least four different failures
'Training.', a silence, and the chant as the last sound
never: anything from the game: no Nether, no lava, no mobs, no crafting, no game mechanics, no Minecraft jokes
the owner's own lines from his script, or another film's
a hook that opens on a face, a title or a sentence of narration
the main character finding any of it funny

camera.note: Hard cuts. A script line with action under it is cut into several pictures with `cut:`.

film.shortsRule: A vertical video over 3:00 is not a YouTube Short. No film of this topic comes near it.

models.note: No APPROVED film yet. The first one built is src/videos/the-barber-who-never-went-to-parties; its kit.tsx holds every part a second film would want (the block town street, the living room, the shop, people with hair that can be cut).

sound.note: Borrowed from Topics/InThisTown/topic.json, except: no owner's track (that track belongs to the In This Town shorts), so the music is written from moods, one for each scene; more effects a minute and a shorter longest gap, because half of a film of this topic has no words over it.
